note: Canonical topic catalog. Tag every question with LEAF names (the `name` field), most-specific first. Categories are for browsing/filtering only — derive them from the leaf, never store a category on a question. A `cross_cutting` leaf combines with a content leaf (e.g. ["trójkąty", "dowodzenie / dowody"]).

migration.instructions: This revision carves new leaves out of the old catch-alls (`geometria`, `bryły`, `inne`). When re-tagging existing questions, decide tags from the question CONTENT against this catalog — do NOT mechanically copy the old coarse tags. Keep multi-tagging: a content leaf plus any cross_cutting leaf (e.g. `pole i obwód`, `dowodzenie / dowody`).
rules: Old `geometria`: reclassify to `czworokąty` / `kąty` / `symetrie` / `układ współrzędnych` (or `trójkąty` / `koła / okręgi`) as content dictates; keep `geometria` only when genuinely general. Add cross-cutting `pole i obwód` whenever the task is computing area or perimeter.
Old `bryły`: assign `graniastosłupy` (sześcian, prostopadłościan, graniastosłup) or `ostrosłupy`; keep `bryły` only for round solids (walec/stożek/kula) or mixed/general.
`inne` in the śląskie 'Konkurs ... z Elementami Przyrody' contest that is a nature/science item → `przyroda`.
Fraction-arithmetic items previously in `inne` or untagged → `ułamki`.
Number-line / coordinate items previously in `inne` or `geometria` → `układ współrzędnych`.
General algebraic-expression building or simplifying → `wyrażenia algebraiczne`.
Do not split `trójkąty`; `trójkąty`↔`geometria` co-tagging is fine. Leave already well-tagged questions alone.
